title: The Parton Printer's Alley - 2 Blocks to Broadway
description:
Welcome to XENOS's downtown Nashville condo - steps from Printer's Alley & Broadway's Honky Tonks, with all the room and comfort you need to settle in and experience Music City properly.

- Sleeps 8 | 2 bedrooms | 5 beds | 2.5 baths
- Prime location across from Printer's Alley
- Full kitchen w/ Keurig, cooking basics & dining table
- 2 ensuite baths + half bath | bathtub | hair dryer & essentials
- WiFi, workspace, A/C, heating & TV
- Pet-friendly | smart lock self check-in | paid parking

The space
Fall in Nashville hits differently when you're two blocks from Broadway - the smell of live music and smoky bars drifting through the crisp October air, neon lights painting the streets as the city shifts into its after-dark rhythm. This 3rd Avenue North condo puts you right at the edge of it all, directly across from Printer's Alley, close enough to feel the pulse of Music City and far enough to come home to actual quiet.

Sleeping arrangements
Two bedrooms on the lower level each offer a queen bed and an ensuite bath, with blackout conditions built for real rest after late nights out. Upstairs in the main living area, a sofa bed and a trundle with two twin beds round out the sleeping options - five beds total, comfortably sleeping up to eight guests.

Living spaces
The parlor and living area give everyone room to exhale. Whether you're starting the morning slow with coffee or recapping the night's highlights, the soft seating and relaxed layout make it easy to settle in. A ceiling fan keeps the air moving, and the dedicated workspace means remote workers and itinerary-planners both have a spot to set up.

Kitchen & dining
The full kitchen comes equipped with a refrigerator, freezer, stove, oven, microwave, and dishwasher. Cooking basics, dishes and silverware, a toaster, blender, and baking sheet are all on hand. The Keurig coffee maker comes with starter pods, creamer, and sweetener - and wine glasses are ready for evenings that call for something slower. Pull up a chair at the dining table and let the night wind down at your own pace.

Bathrooms
Two ensuite bathrooms plus a half bath keep mornings moving smoothly for a full group. Each is stocked with shampoo, conditioner, body soap, hot water, and towels. A hair dryer, cleaning products, and toilet paper are included, and the bathtub gives you the option to properly decompress after a full day on your feet.

Amenities & comfort
Wi-Fi and a dedicated workspace keep you connected. Air conditioning, heating, and a ceiling fan handle comfort across the seasons. Bed linens, extra pillows and blankets, hangers, iron, and clothing storage are all provided. The TV rounds out the downstairs when you're staying in.

Safety & access
Getting in is straightforward - self check-in via smart lock means no coordination required. The building has smoke and carbon monoxide alarms, a fire extinguisher, and exterior security cameras in common areas (not inside units). Paid parking is available off premises.

Neighborhood
On foot, you're a short walk from Broadway's live music venues, Bridgestone Arena, Nissan Stadium, Music City Center, and the Cumberland riverfront. By car, East Nashville, West Nashville, Vanderbilt, Belmont, and Green Hills are all within easy reach.

This XENOS Guest-Friend condo is pet-friendly and set up for both short stays and longer visits - a real home base in one of the most energetic neighborhoods in the country.

Note
Parking is NOT provided. There are several parking garages and lots located on the block for convenient parking. ($20-40+ per 24 hour period). We recommend using the city's public transportation and ride sharing with visiting.
